columns.name: SLL 38,76,994 42,97,476 45,86,986 Non-Cognizable crimes are generally left to be pursued by the affected parties themselves in courts. Police does not initiate investigation in non-cognizable crimes except with magisterial permission. The First schedule of the Cr.P.C. gives the classification of the offences of the IPC into cognizable and non-cognizable. There are few Central Law Enforcing Agencies characterised as ‘Special Investigation Agencies’ which also register cognizable crimes, investigate and place results to ‘Normal’ or ‘Special’ Courts, for trial. They include ‘the Central Bureau of Investigation’, ‘the Directorate of Enforcement’, ‘the Central Board of Direct Taxes’, ‘the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence’, ‘the Directorate of Preventive Operations’, ‘the Narcotics Control Bureau’, ‘the Directorate General of foreign Trade’, ‘the Directorate of Income Tax’ at the Centre and the Agencies like ‘the Directorates of Vigilance’, ‘the Directorates of Enforcement’, ‘the forest Cells’ etc. at New and sophisticated methods of committing traditional crimes, exploitations of existing loopholes Institutions has called for new enacimenis and specialised investigation agencies to deal with them. For the last 8 years, these details have been tabulated separately under Chapter on Economic Offences/Miccellancanc. During 1996 in addition to the 62,96,562 cognizable crimes and the other investigating agencies under the Central and State Governments also registered 82,682 cognizable crimes. Thus, crimes registered by the aforesaid agencies increases the cognizahle crimes registered from 62,96,562 to 63,79,244. The agency-wise No. of cases registered
